regime_context: The Canada/TSX detector shows broad eligibility (14 of 16 themes) with Gold Miners as the top leader and Base Metals & Copper as challenger; REITs rank last with zero breadth. Macro headline flow is AI/tech- and geopolitics-heavy, but cross-sectional rank and rotation timing are display-only and past directional accuracy is 0.39, so all leans stay low-conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch the Gold Miners vs Base Metals & Copper leadership margin; if XBM.TO consistently outranks XGD.TO for five consecutive trading days, retire this watch.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the current leadership theme with the strongest trend-gate eligibility and high breadth. The support comes from the absolute-trend gate being validated for this market, breadth=1.0, and no crowding; it is not a rank-based buy.
theses.dissent: The leadership may already be discounted; gold could mean-revert if the macro narrative shifts away from geopolitics/AI-driven uncertainty, and theme momentum has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO lags S&P/TSX Composite by 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is the rotation challenger and also passes the absolute-trend gate with full breadth and no crowding. Low conviction because rotation timing is display-only and there is no confirmed handoff from Gold Miners.
evidence: rank=2 and rotation margin to leader = 0.293
theses.dissent: A challenger can stall; copper/industrial beta may fade if global macro headlines remain dominated by geopolitics and unscheduled surprises.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO lags S&P/TSX Composite by 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: REITs
theses.thesis: REITs sits last with zero breadth and the weakest durability among eligible scorable themes. This is a low-conviction de-risk direction, not a short: absence of participation plus weak durability argues for staying light.
theses.dissent: Zero breadth could be a coiled spring if rate/news conditions shift; REITs can rally sharply on macro surprises, and rank has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: XRE.TO outperforms S&P/TSX Composite by 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the 30-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
